annotations.title: Get the API token's permissions and usage

description: What this server's API token may do (its permission rules, without the token value), the plan's limits, and the account's usage this month (requestCount, requestsRemaining, credits, storageBytes, storageAllowance, degraded). Also checks the token works. Call it first when anything fails with an authentication or permission error, and before a large batch of writes. 1 request.
